userStories.title: Create range_reconcile.py — on-chain balance reconciliation for range trader
userStories.description:
Port the reconciliation pattern from businesses/horizen-zkverify/base-trader/scripts/reconcile.py, adapted for the Range Trader:

1. Create businesses/horizen-zkverify/range-trader/scripts/range_reconcile.py
2. Read range_positions.json from data/
3. For each open position:
   - Query on-chain token balance via web3 balanceOf using METAMASK_WALLET_ADDRESS
   - If balance == 0, mark position as removed and log to data/range_reconcile_log.jsonl
   - If balance > 0, update tokens_held in the position
4. Rewrite range_positions.json if any changes
5. Use same Base RPC and ERC20 ABI as range_execute.py

Also wire into run_range_pipeline.py:
- Import reconcile from range_reconcile
- Call it at pipeline start, before scanning (same pattern as base-trader)
- Non-fatal: if reconcile fails, log warning and continue

Constraints:
- Use METAMASK_WALLET_ADDRESS from env (not BASE_WALLET_ADDRESS)
- Use range_positions.json (not positions.json)
- Log to range_reconcile_log.jsonl (separate from base-trader logs)
- Can import get_web3 from range_execute.py or define own
userStories.notes: Implemented US-001: Created range_reconcile.py that reads range_positions.json, checks on-chain token balances via web3 balanceOf using METAMASK_WALLET_ADDRESS, marks positions with zero balance as 'r

userStories.title: Create range_verifier.py — post-trade position verification for range trader
userStories.description:
Port the verification pattern from businesses/horizen-zkverify/base-trader/scripts/verifier.py, adapted for Range Trader:

1. Create businesses/horizen-zkverify/range-trader/scripts/range_verifier.py
2. For each position in range_positions.json:
   - Query on-chain token balance via web3 using METAMASK_WALLET_ADDRESS
   - Get current price from GeckoTerminal (import get_price from range_scanner)
   - Compute current_usd = token_balance * price_usd
   - Compare with entry_usdc from position, compute discrepancy_pct
   - Check if price is at/below stop_loss
   - Log result to data/range_verifier_log.jsonl
   - On FAIL: send Telegram alert
3. Return exit code 0 (all pass) or 1 (any fail)

Also wire into run_range_pipeline.py:
- At end of pipeline (after all trading), run verifier
- Log verifier output

Constraints:
- Use METAMASK_WALLET_ADDRESS from env
- Get prices from GeckoTerminal (import from range_scanner), NOT Nansen
- Separate log file from base-trader (range_verifier_log.jsonl)
- PASS if: discrepancy_pct < 25% AND token_balance > 0 (wider threshold than base-trader's 20% because small-cap tokens are more volatile)
userStories.notes:
